# References {.unnumbered}

All the sources cited in the handbook, in alphabetical order by author.
Each entry gives, whenever available, its **DOI** (open it as
`https://doi.org/<DOI>`), its **arXiv** identifier, its **ISBN** or its
**URL**, followed by a note on **how to obtain it** and **which parts the book
uses**. @sec-finding-sources explains how to find and read each kind of
source.

::: {#refs}
:::
